lastBuilt.notes:
• Returns: a discounted sale never refunds more than was paid — returned line by line, in small parts, or after the credit was paid off
• Paying twice by mistake (Pay pressed again after a slow answer) makes one sale, not two
• The drawer and the Z report: a sale paid during a close, cash refunds and two withdrawals at once are all counted right
• Customers: payments and advance refunds at the same moment never pay off or refund twice; the credit limit holds on two tills
• Stock: a count saved while selling no longer overwrites those sales; whole-piece items never take fractions
• Suppliers: deliveries, payments and goods sent back at the same moment are booked once; sending a whole delivery back clears its bill to the cent
• Reports: opening stock is no longer counted as profit; a return counts on the day it was given; the Sales report leaves out tax and voided sales; the Tax report shows tax given back
• Pharmacy: a patient picked at the till gets the dispense written with the sale
• Combos: the combo report takes returned sets off
• Backups: a backup taken while selling restores whole, a restore never loses a sale made at that moment, and the copies kept before a restore or an update stay 30 days
• Updates: a power cut during an update always leaves Karots able to start, and if a new version can't start, the old one comes back and keeps selling
